thesis: Ben Horowitz argues that traditional venture capital models are outdated because they assume only 15 technology companies will reach $100 million in revenue, whereas the rise of software suggests 200 could. He contends that sharing control among partners makes it difficult to change an organization and that firms must scale beyond the traditional small partnership structure to effectively support entrepreneurs.
